mapper.sql: select id, order_id, good_id, deal_price, `count`, good_name, good_pic, good_desc, description from order_item
mapper.insert: insert into order_item (order_id, good_id, deal_price, `count`, good_name, good_pic, good_desc, description) values (#{orderId}, #{goodId}, #{dealPrice}, #{count}, #{goodName}, #{goodPic}, #{goodDesc}, #{description})
